def compute(num, length, p=[0]*17):
    if p[1] == 0:
        for i in range(1, 17):
            p[i] = p[i - 1] * 10 + 1
    if length == 0:
        return 0
    quotient = num // p[length]
    remainder = num % p[length]
    option1 = quotient * length
    option2 = 0
    if remainder != 0:
        res1 = compute(remainder, length - 1, p)
        res2 = length + compute(p[length] - remainder, length - 1, p)
        option2 = min(res1, res2)
    return option1 + option2

n = int(input())
print(compute(n, 16))
